## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 executes the EVOI rank-9b texture-cluster magnitude axis under the two workshop-pinned conventions that S100a froze: the W-2 counting convention (`RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN` — every mass-bearing channel functional is a state evaluation ρ_g(f(D_K)) of ρ_g = P_g/Tr(P_g); block-SUM excluded for mass use) and the W-3 carrier reading (READING A, twice-scoped, ONE OBJECT / THREE CHARTS; Reading B retired as carrier with its residual live content exactly this wave's composite gate). The wave runs the W_flat measurement on the amended six-item BINDING pre-registration (W2-1), the 3-leg carrier discriminator that consumes W2-1's npz under the SAME audit SHA (W2-2; Rider 1 — one dataset, two gates), the downstream S₀-knob discrimination armed against the (i)/(iii) 0.52% shadow degeneracy (W2-3), the quark-component orientation [SIGN] pre-registration plus first quark envelope (W2-4), and the two Connes-machinery boundary verifies of Lemma B and Theorem A clause 3 (W2-5, W2-6).

The within-wave structure is two independent chains: **W2a = widening chain (1 → 2 → 3)** — gate 1 publishes the ⟨λ²⟩_g triple npz + OLS slope s̄(τ_fold); gate 2's Leg A consumes that npz (SAME SHA) while its Legs B/C run the pair-resolved coherence solve and the first-principles ε_LX split derivation; gate 3's exactly-one-candidate criterion runs DOWNSTREAM of gate 2's Leg C output-form binary. **W2b = Connes machinery (4 ‖ 5 ‖ 6)** — three mutually independent gates on the existing L12 cache + SDP machinery; no new diagonalization anywhere in this wave.

**Route-fork closure (carried from the W-2 workshop, BINDING)**: the star-metric face is closed-form-identical to the trace-mean face — d(v,g) = 1/t_g with t_g = 1/⟨λ²⟩_g (resp. 1/⟨ω⟩_g) gives d_g = ⟨λ²⟩_g (resp. ⟨ω⟩_g) EXACTLY (star closed form; SDP dev 2.5e-09, audit `5e24db72e3e5121b`). Gate 1's verdict therefore binds BOTH the overlap-route and the metric-route successor claims; the W2-4 §-Assessment forward route (t_g = 1/⟨ω⟩_g) is SUBSUMED and NO separate S101 Connes-route shape gate exists in this plan (one compute, both routes; the fork closes by theorem, not by choice).

**Counting-convention lockdown (PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class 1)**: gates 1–4 emit `convention=RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN` (fifth pin axis, `regulator-pin-discipline.md` Counting row). Re-running any of these observables under `RATIO-BLOCKSUM` post-hoc is PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class 1 (convention-shopping) per `v3-closure-recovery.md`; the block-sum class is closed for mass-functional use by the s100a-w2 workshop adjudication (it remains legitimate ONLY for extensive observables — degeneracy/occupation/relic/action-moment statistics, none of which this wave gates).

**Evidence-counting pins (inherited)**: one-straddle rule (W3-10 ∧ W3-11 = ONE phenomenon, E_A = 2π·S0_threshold exact) + NO stacked-odds arithmetic at any verdict layer (W-3 D-2, accepted by both workshop agents). Per-leg weights stand qualitatively; the gates decide.

  content: |
    Claim 1 (ordering direction): "⟨λ²⟩₁₀ < ⟨λ²⟩₁₁ < ⟨λ²⟩₃₀ at τ=0 EXACTLY, hence the

                  C₂(1,0) = 4/3;  C₂(1,1) = 3;  C₂(3,0) = 6   (strictly increasing)
    Definition 2: ⟨λ²⟩_g(τ=0) = 3·C₂(g) + 27/4           [LC t=1/2 trace-mean closed form,
                  W-2 A-C1/B2 + W-3 E-R2.2; (ρ,ρ)=3 units]
    Substitute:   ⟨λ²⟩₁₀(0) = 3·(4/3) + 27/4 = 4 + 27/4 = 43/4
                  ⟨λ²⟩₁₁(0) = 3·3 + 27/4     = 9 + 27/4 = 63/4
                  ⟨λ²⟩₃₀(0) = 3·6 + 27/4     = 18 + 27/4 = 99/4
    Simplify:     43/4 < 63/4 < 99/4 — strict, monotone in C₂.
    Direction:    ordering ASCENDS with C₂ at τ=0; the freeze-in direction theorem
                  (kernel-independent sign: deeper freeze at larger C₂ ⟹ lighter fermion)
                  maps mass DESCENDING along the ladder ⟹ heavy pair τ = (1,0) (smallest
                  C₂, heaviest), μ = (1,1), e = (3,0) (largest C₂, lightest).
    Conclusion:   sign sub-criterion = persistence of the strict ascent at τ_fold;
                  violation ⇒ sign FAIL (closes the normalized-counting corridor too —
                  the weighted-face check makes the violation counting-position-universal).

    Claim 2 (τ=0 control value): "W_flat(τ=0) = 9/5 EXACT."
    Substitute:   W_flat(0) = (⟨λ²⟩₃₀ − ⟨λ²⟩₁₁)/(⟨λ²⟩₁₁ − ⟨λ²⟩₁₀)
                            = (99/4 − 63/4)/(63/4 − 43/4)
                            = (36/4)/(20/4) = 36/20 = 9/5
    Simplify:     equivalently (C₂(3,0) − C₂(1,1))/(C₂(1,1) − C₂(1,0)) = (6−3)/(3−4/3)
                  = 3/(5/3) = 9/5 — the 27/4 offset cancels in the gap ratio; any global
                  unit factor (frame-unit map LT/9) cancels identically.
    Conclusion:   W_flat(τ=0) = 9/5 = 1.800 EXACT, canonicity-branch-invariant in ratio.
                  This IS the PASS-band lower edge: the magnitude gate asks whether the
                  fold keeps W_flat within [9/5, 1.8894] (Casimir-shape corridor
                  survives) vs re-keys it to the fundamental tower (4/3 ± 0.05, INFO) vs
                  neither (FAIL — envelope shape is fold-dynamical, feeding the W-3
                  freeze-in reading).

Thresholds transcribed, NOT re-derived.

**Executor decision (documented)**: ONE dispatch, `transit-dynamics-theorist` executes all three legs and emits the single composite verdict line. Rationale: Legs B and C are transit-owned (workshop routing, Effected item 2); Leg A is a fully-pinned mechanical post-processing step (one OLS consumption + one closed-form assembly — zero judgment remains; its SPEC was authored and frozen by connes in the workshop). The per-leg agent attributions (Leg A = connes, Legs B/C = transit) are derivation-AUTHOR tags per `Investigating-Workshops.md` §"is NOT" item 8, not executor tags; they are preserved in the per-leg extra_rows. One gate = one writer = one verdict line (output-file discipline).

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim 1 (Leg-A band edges in s̄-space — D-3, transcribed verbatim as the mechanical
            no-band-stretch check):
    Step 1: S₀^geo = 3·τ_fold·s̄/T_acoustic = (95/56)·(3·s̄)   [(C1-7), q = τ_fold pinned;

    Step 3: 3·s̄ ≤ 1.779×56/95 = 99.624/95 = 1.048674  ⇒  s̄ ≤ 0.349558
    Step 4: full-J end: J(τ_fold)/3 = 1.047319/3 = 0.349106
    Step 5: 0.349558/0.349106 = 1.001294  ⇒  +0.129% headroom above full scalar tilt
    Step 6 (lower edge): S₀^geo ≥ 1.609 ⇒ 3·s̄ ≥ 1.609×56/95 = 0.948463
            ⇒ s̄ ≥ 0.316154 — i.e. 5.15% BELOW the τ=0 slope 1/3.
    Conclusion: PASS window in s̄-space = [0.316154, 0.349558] M_KK² per unit C₂ —
            generous to anti-tilt (−5.15%), razor above the scalar prior (+0.13%).
            If s̄ lands in (0.349558, J/3 + ε], that is a GENUINE Leg-A miss — the tilt
            bracket may NOT be invoked to re-classify it (connes commitment Re:T1(4),
            mechanically checkable here). An in-window upper-half landing IS the first
            Dirac-channel tilt measurement, t = (S₀^geo·56/95 − 1)/(J − 1) ∈ [0, 1].

    Claim 2 (Leg-B feasibility ceiling direction — E-R2.1, transcribed):
    Definition: M = (1+c)·diag(d) − c·u u†, u_i = √d_i (all-π block, real).
    Substitute (matrix-determinant lemma):
        det M = det((1+c)·D)·(1 − c·u†((1+c)D)^{-1}u)
              = (1+c)³·d₁d₂d₃·(1 − (c/(1+c))·Σ_i d_i/d_i)     [|u_i|² = d_i]
              = (1+c)³·d₁d₂d₃·(1 − 3c/(1+c))
        Simplify: = (1+c)²·(1−2c)·d₁d₂d₃
    Direction: M ≻ 0 ⟺ c < 1/2, for ANY diagonal d (first eigenvalue zero-crossing
            forces det = 0; only root in (0,1) is c = 1/2).
    Conclusion: c_req ≥ 1/2 ⟺ ratio = c_req/(1/√6) ≥ (1/2)·√6 = √6/2 = 1.224745 is
            POSITIVE-CONE-INFEASIBLE: the upper failure mode manifests as
            solve-infeasibility (exclusion of the all-π rank-one texture CLASS), inside
            the nominal INFO edge 1.25. Bands stand exactly as pre-registered; this
            chain specifies the FAILURE MODE, not a band edit.

    Claim 3 (Leg-C graded-form direction): GRADED means ω_g = q·C₂(g)·M_KK with ONE q
            across the tower — Casimir-linear in g (the same linearity that makes
            W_flat(τ=0) = 9/5 exact). SCALAR means ω_g = ω₀ (g-independent gap).
            The binary is STRUCTURAL (functional form), not a magnitude band — the
            (i)/(iii) 0.52% shadow degeneracy (2π·τ_fold = 1.19380 vs 1.2, dev 0.52%)
            cannot be resolved by a tighter ratio band; only the output-FORM can split it.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
# Schema-v2 3-tuple semantics (pre-registered):
#   sign_verdict      = the composite rule itself (PASS iff Leg A ∈ {PASS,INFO} ∧
#                       Leg B ∈ {PASS,INFO}; FAIL otherwise) — the workshop's directional
#                       content IS the Reading-A conjunction.
#   magnitude_verdict = Leg A's band status at the GOVERNING read-out (primary q=τ_fold,
#                       or q′ under the fired supersession) — PASS/INFO/FAIL per T1.0.
#   regime_verdict    = VALID iff Leg-B positive-cone feasible (c_req < 1/2) AND solver
#                       clean; MARGINAL iff Leg C lands SCALAR (moduli-acoustic magnitude
#                       identification withdrawn; carrier verdict unaffected); BREAKDOWN
#                       iff Leg-B solve-infeasible (ratio ≥ 1.224745 — the all-π rank-one
#                       texture class dies; composite FAIL, consistent with Leg-B FAIL).
# Top-line: GATE-BLOCK OPERATOR (workshop CF-1) with the pre-declared precedence
# disclosure extra-row. Conflict cells resolved in the operator's favor, disclosed.
PASS_meaning: >
  READING A CONFIRMED (Leg A ∈ {PASS, INFO} ∧ Leg B ∈ {PASS, INFO}): the envelope's
  shape (tracial chart), magnitude (moduli-acoustic crossing at q), and coherence
  (Weingarten hub fraction) cohere as ONE operator family read on three charts. If Leg C
  also lands GRADED with q′ ≈ τ_fold, the magnitude identification is DERIVED, not
  fingerprint — feeding W2-3's candidate (iii).
FAIL_meaning: >
  Leg A = FAIL ∨ Leg B = FAIL. ATTRIBUTION is read from the W_flat coupling (recorded in
  extra-rows, adjudicated at synthesis): Leg-A-FAIL ∧ W_flat-PASS = Reading-B evidence
  (the one pre-registered revival outcome); Leg-A-FAIL ∧ W_flat-FAIL =
  carriers-inconclusive. Leg-B FAIL above 1.224745 = positive-cone infeasibility — the
  all-π rank-one texture CLASS is excluded (sharper than a band miss; E-R2.1).
INFO_meaning: >
  RESERVED for the non-evaluable degenerate only: Leg-B solver non-convergence that is
  NOT positive-cone infeasibility (CLARABEL numerical failure), or Leg A
  PRE-REG-INC-blocked with Legs B/C landed (per the prerequisite table). The failing leg
  is named in the value field; the composite is NOT evaluable and the gate re-queues.

  generation-dependent up/down crossing (gen-1 inverted, gen-3 upright) — the hardest

  contradicts the κ-image ordering where PDG confirms it (m_t ≫ m_b) — the κ-triple
  prior is falsified in its only safe cell. Globally anti-oriented magnitude = same.
INFO_meaning: >
  Directions hold but NO crossing (uniform ordering): the uniform-κ sub-reading's
  pre-declared FAIL stands recorded (gen-1 inversion unmet by the construction); the
  orientation content is banked and the crossing question routes to per-generation

  b-component (leptons) reads the |s(h)|²-weighted face; the D-component (h·D₊·h̄,
  adjoint-action class) and c-component read the quark faces. The W-2/W-3 tier-3

## §W2-5. S101-STAR-METRIC-BLOCK-LEMMA

**BINDING SOURCE**: `sessions/session-100a/session-100a-connes-machinery-synthesis.md` §V.1 (lines 204–208) + landscape §V.13 (:218–222). **Agent choice (documented)**: `gen-physicist`, NOT connes-ncg-theorist — connes is excluded ONLY from the BM.STATE-PROJ Stage-2 VERIFY (Wave 7), not from these computes; assigning gen-physicist here is zero-cost author-independence hygiene on a boundary verify of connes's own Stage-0 Lemma B (the SDP machinery is fully scripted in `s100a_connes_distance_ladder.py`), NOT a requirement.

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S101-STAR-METRIC-BLOCK-LEMMA"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY-THEOREM]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "gen-physicist"
hypothesis: >
  Lemma B holds at its declared boundary: (i) for NON-SCALAR channel couplings S_g
  (operator blocks), the hub-leaf star distance is d(v,g) = 1/‖S_g‖_op EXACTLY; and
  (ii) the leaf-leaf distance is STRICTLY above the Pythagorean form
  (t_g⁻² + t_h⁻²)^{1/2} for non-aligned blocks (top singular subspaces misaligned),
  with equality restored under engineered alignment — the saturation criterion of
  Lemma B(2).

method:
  description: >
    SDP machinery reused from `s100a_connes_distance_ladder.py` (cvxpy CLARABEL,
    gauge-fixing as scripted); NO new diagonalization.
    (1) SYNTHETIC FAMILY (plan-frozen; the binding text leaves the parameterization to
    the gate — pinned HERE to close the PRU freedom): star graphs with hub v and 3
    leaves; channel couplings S_g = 2×2 operator blocks with top-singular-subspace
    misalignment angle θ ∈ {0°, 15°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 75°, 90°} between the two leaves
    under test, at coupling magnitudes ‖S_g‖_op ∈ {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} — 21 non-trivial
    configurations; θ = 0° rows double as the engineered-alignment equality controls.
    (2) PHYSICAL INSTANCE (the ε_LX-boundary probe of synthesis §II.2): scalar part
    from the L12 cache floors (the W2-4 star construction) + a multiplicity-textured
    perturbation promoting the scalar couplings to operator blocks on the
    multiplicity index — 1 instance + its aligned control.
    (3) For every configuration: closed-form d(v,g) = 1/‖S_g‖_op vs SDP distance
    (clause (i), rel dev ≤ 1e-7); leaf-leaf SDP distance vs Pythagorean form
    (clause (ii): strictness witness (d − P)/P ≥ 1e-3 non-aligned; |d − P|/P ≤ 1e-7
    aligned). Total ≈ 30 small SDPs (21 synthetic + controls + physical), matching the
    binding effort line.
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_star_metric_block_lemma.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "conjunction of two clause tests (equality + strictness-with-saturation)"
  form: >
    clause (i):  max over family of |d_SDP(v,g) − 1/‖S_g‖_op| / (1/‖S_g‖_op) ≤ 1e-7
    clause (ii): (d_SDP(g,h) − P)/P ≥ 1e-3 for every non-aligned configuration AND
                 |d_SDP(g,h) − P|/P ≤ 1e-7 for every aligned configuration,
                 with P = (t_g⁻² + t_h⁻²)^{1/2}
    PASS iff (i) ∧ (ii).

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "1e-7 (clause-(i) rel dev, and aligned-equality rel dev); 1e-3 (relative strictness witness, non-aligned)"
  direction: "≤ (equalities) / ≥ (strictness witness)"

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    Lemma B(1) closed form d(v,g) = 1/‖S_g‖ is the synthesis's PROVEN Stage-0 text
    (connes-machinery synthesis §VI row 2; SDP residual 2.5e-9 at the landed scalar
    instance, audit 5e24db72e3e5121b — the 1e-7 threshold sits 40× above the observed
    solver floor). The Pythagorean form is exact for scalar couplings (Lemma B(2));
    non-scalar saturation iff aligned is the clause-(ii) criterion under test.

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "21-point synthetic grid (7 angles × 3 magnitudes) + aligned controls + 1 physical instance — discrete plan-frozen family; observables are float64 SDP values"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "≈30 SDPs (21 synthetic + 7 aligned-equality controls + 1 physical + 1 physical-aligned control)"
  L_max: "12 (cache floors for the physical instance only)"
  scan_range: "θ ∈ {0,15,30,45,60,75,90}°; ‖S_g‖_op ∈ {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} (plan-frozen synthetic family)"
  step_size: "discrete grid as pinned"
  tolerance: "1e-7 (clause i + aligned equality); 1e-3 (strictness witness); CLARABEL default tolerances as scripted in s100a_connes_distance_ladder.py"
  scheme: "SDP-CLARABEL-LEMMA-B-BOUNDARY"
  convention: "substrate-state-pair-canonical"   # Connes-distance convention lineage (S100a W2-4);
                                                 # NOT a counting-axis observable (no mass-functional use)
  corner_cell: "algebra-DEPENDENT state-pair functional family — Cell IV per the S-1 §IV.2 STATE-PROJ declaration (cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md algebra-axis orthogonality; declared here because the observable is state-pair-metric machinery; NO registry landing in this gate — the landing is Wave 6's)"
  solver: "cvxpy CLARABEL (machinery file SHA pinned in ledger); gauge-fixing per the s100a script"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (fixed grid, no sampling)"
  GPU_path: "CPU (SDPs are CLARABEL interior-point; OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 cap)"
  # No Seeley-DeWitt a_n cited → no regulator_pin. No SCHEMATIC helper → no CLASS pin.
  publication_precision: "3 sig figs on witnesses (WP); npz full float64"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "s84_cache_sha", "sdp_machinery_sha"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (strictness direction): "non-aligned operator blocks make the leaf-leaf
            distance STRICTLY EXCEED the Pythagorean form; alignment restores equality."
    Definition 1: hub-leaf: d(v,g) = 1/‖S_g‖_op   [Lemma B(1), operator-norm form]
    Definition 2: leaf-leaf Pythagorean: P = (t_g⁻² + t_h⁻²)^{1/2} with t_x = ‖S_x‖_op
                  [Lemma B(2), exact for SCALAR couplings]
    Substitute:   the Connes distance is a sup over Lipschitz elements; for scalar
                  couplings ONE element saturates both channel constraints
                  simultaneously (the constraints commute — same singular direction),
                  giving d = P exactly. For OPERATOR blocks with misaligned top singular
                  subspaces, no single element saturates both constraints at once: the
                  optimizing element splits its Lipschitz budget across the two
                  non-commuting directions.
    Simplify:     constrained sup with jointly-unsaturatable constraints ⟹ the
                  achievable distance EXCEEDS the both-saturated (Pythagorean) value:
                  d(g,h) > P strictly, non-aligned.
    Direction:    d − P > 0 non-aligned; d − P → 0 as θ → 0 (alignment restores joint
                  saturation — the Lemma B(2) saturation criterion).
    Conclusion:   strictness witness (d − P)/P ≥ 1e-3 at the plan-frozen non-aligned
                  grid; equality ≤ 1e-7 at θ = 0 controls. A clause-(i) deviation
                  anywhere falsifies the operator-norm form itself.

input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  s84_cache:
    path: "computations/session-84/s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz"
    sha256: "9e6d9cf7fd6a6949d622441b26fb9c2fa568654a22dc802e99898c326ca0f8d9"
  sdp_machinery:

    sha256: "fe31ed40146a9aa148ecb72a4161b130d256cde8beeeb5c3d4a78df1a31bb97e"
  connes_ladder_npz:
    path: "computations/session-100a/s100a_connes_distance_ladder.npz"
    sha256: "04a0062bdb94ff5e911695b71835d0a93923b99b98a2eb669adee1cee634e737"
    # scalar-instance floors + solver-floor reference 2.5e-9 (audit 5e24db72e3e5121b)

# ---- fb_pair ----
fb_pair:
  forward: >
    S-1 connes-machinery synthesis Lemma B (PROVEN Stage-0 text, §VI row 2);
    S100a-CONNES-DISTANCE-LADDER (INFO, 5e24db72 — scalar instance + solver floor);
    S101-TAU0 L4 lift (cache floors).
  backward: >
    S101-VIIBM-STATEPROJ-LANDING (Wave 6) cites Lemma B in its structural clauses — a
    clause-(i) FAIL here HALTS that landing as drafted (remediation: exclude/re-scope
    the falsified clause); S101-CONNES-STATEPROJ-STAGE2-VERIFY (Wave 7) inherits
    whichever text lands. The ε_LX-boundary probe feeds the §VII.BL-complement
    boundary characterization.

# ---- Output artifacts ----
output_artifacts:
  script:
    path: "computations/session-101/s101_star_metric_block_lemma.py"
    artifact_kind: "script"
    must_contain:
      - "from canonical_constants import"
      - "print_verdict_payload"
  data:
    path: "computations/session-101/s101_star_metric_block_lemma.npz"
    artifact_kind: "data"
    optional: false
  plot:
    path: "computations/session-101/s101_star_metric_block_lemma.png"
    artifact_kind: "plot"
    optional: false
  verdict_line:
    path: "computations/session-101/s101_gate_verdicts.txt"
    artifact_kind: "verdict_line"
    must_contain: "^S101-STAR-METRIC-BLOCK-LEMMA:.* audit_sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}"
    companion_row_required: true
    schema_v2_3tuple_required: false       # [VERIFY-THEOREM] — no directional pre-registration beyond the clause structure
    # extra_rows: A19 extra-row iff pre-lift dispatch.
  wp_section:
    path: "sessions/session-101/session-101-w2-workingpaper.md"
    artifact_kind: "wp_section"
    section_anchor: "### §W2-5. S101-STAR-METRIC-BLOCK-LEMMA"
    must_contain:

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Lemma B is verified AT ITS BOUNDARY: the operator-norm form d(v,g) = 1/‖S_g‖_op holds
  exactly for non-scalar couplings, and the leaf-leaf Pythagorean form is the ALIGNED

## §W2-6. S101-CONNES-DISTANCE-DISCONNECT-BOUNDARY

**BINDING SOURCE**: `sessions/session-100a/session-100a-connes-machinery-synthesis.md` §V.2 (lines 210–214) + landscape §V.14 (:224–228). Same agent rationale as §W2-5.

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S101-CONNES-DISTANCE-DISCONNECT-BOUNDARY"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY-THEOREM]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "gen-physicist"
hypothesis: >
  Theorem A clause 3 holds at its boundary: severing one star edge (t_g = 0) makes the
  severed pair's Frobenius-regulated distance d_R grow with log-log slope EXACTLY 1
  (linear-in-R divergence — the commutative CLASS-γ signature), while all connected
  pairs stay R-flat; the connected-pair activation threshold ρ* (the one empirical
  residue of the S-1 synthesis) satisfies ρ* ≤ 10·ω_max.

method:
  description: >
    Same SDP machinery and cache floors as §W2-5; NO new diagonalization.
    (1) Build the W2-4 star at the L12 cache floors. (2) SEVER pinned edge: PRIMARY
    severed edge = the (1,0) channel (t_{(1,0)} = 0; plan-frozen to close the
    which-edge PRU freedom); DIAGNOSTIC repeats on (1,1) and (3,0) severances
    (non-gating robustness rows). (3) Run the Frobenius-regulated SDP over the
    R-sweep grid R ∈ {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000} × ω_max — the s100a grid
    (10/100/1000 × ω_max) extended ONE DECADE EACH WAY per the binding text, with
    ω_max defined by the s100a_connes_distance_ladder.py convention (loaded from its
    npz). (4) Severed pair: OLS fit of ln d_R on ln R → slope; test |slope − 1| ≤ 1e-3.
    (5) Connected pairs: max relative deviation of d_R across the R-grid ≤ 1e-8
    (R-flatness). (6) Activation threshold: ρ* = the R-scale at which connected-pair
    flatness activates, measured per the s100a flatness-window convention; test
    ρ* ≤ 10·ω_max. (7) If the severed-pair SDP flags UNBOUNDED before the largest R:
    acceptable degenerate confirmation of the divergence — emit INFO with the largest
    bounded R named (binding spec).
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_connes_distance_disconnect_boundary.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "conjunction: slope equality + flatness bound + threshold bound"
  form: >
    (a) |d ln d_R / d ln R − 1| ≤ 1e-3   (severed pair, OLS over the 5-point R-grid)
    (b) max_R |d_R/d_R₀ − 1| ≤ 1e-8      (every connected pair; R₀ = grid reference)
    (c) ρ* ≤ 10·ω_max                     (activation threshold consistency)
    PASS iff (a) ∧ (b) ∧ (c).

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "1e-3 (slope dev); 1e-8 (connected R-dev); 10·ω_max (ρ* ceiling)"
  direction: "≤ on all three"

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    Theorem A Step 5 (S-1 synthesis, PROVEN Stage-0): on a DISCONNECTED graph the
    gauge-quotient no longer fixes the relative constant between components; the
    Frobenius regulator's ball radius R is the only scale bounding it, so
    d_R = R·(component-separation constant) — linear in R, log-log slope 1 EXACTLY
    (substitution chain below). The connected-pair flatness floor 1e-8 sits above the
    observed s100a solver residual (R-dev 1.79e-9, synthesis §IV.5 item 3).

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "5-point decade grid {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000} × ω_max (exact decade multipliers); slope target 1 exact integer"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1 primary severance + 2 diagnostic severances; 5-point R-grid each; all pair distances per configuration"
  L_max: "12 (cache floors)"
  scan_range: "R ∈ {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000} × ω_max"
  step_size: "decade steps (exact)"
  tolerance: "1e-3 (slope); 1e-8 (flatness); ρ* ≤ 10·ω_max; CLARABEL defaults per the s100a script"
  scheme: "SDP-CLARABEL-CLASS-GAMMA-DISCONNECT"
  convention: "substrate-state-pair-canonical"
  corner_cell: "algebra-DEPENDENT state-pair functional family — Cell IV (same S-1 §IV.2 declaration as §W2-5; no registry landing in this gate)"
  severed_edge_primary: "(1,0) channel, t = 0 (plan-frozen); diagnostics (1,1), (3,0) non-gating"
  omega_max: "per the s100a_connes_distance_ladder.py convention (loaded from its npz — pinned by file SHA)"
  solver: "cvxpy CLARABEL"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "CPU (CLARABEL; OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 cap)"
  # No Seeley-DeWitt a_n cited → no regulator_pin. No SCHEMATIC helper → no CLASS pin.
  publication_precision: "slope at 6 sig figs; ρ* at 3 sig figs; npz full float64"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "s84_cache_sha", "sdp_machinery_sha"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (slope-1 direction): "the severed pair's regulated distance grows LINEARLY
            in R — log-log slope exactly 1; connected pairs are R-flat."
    Definition 1: Connes distance with Frobenius regulator: d_R(p,q) = sup{|f(p)−f(q)| :
                  ‖[D,f]‖ ≤ 1, ‖f‖_F ≤ R}   [the s100a machinery's regulated form]
    Definition 2: severed edge: t_g = 0 ⟹ the graph splits into two components; the
                  Lipschitz constraint ‖[D,f]‖ ≤ 1 no longer couples f's values across
                  components (no path of nonzero couplings).
    Substitute:   between components, |f(p) − f(q)| is bounded ONLY by the regulator:
                  the optimizer pushes the inter-component offset to the ball edge,
                  |f(p) − f(q)| = c·R with c the component-separation constant fixed by
                  the gauge quotient within each component.
    Simplify:     d_R = c·R  ⟹  ln d_R = ln c + ln R
                  d ln d_R / d ln R = 1   (exactly; c drops out — the multiplicative
                  pre-factor is annihilated by the log-derivative, the
                  math-scripts.md MANDATORY K=3 cancellation pattern on the
                  regulator-scale axis: the SLOPE is the structural content, the
                  intercept ln c is the empirical residue).
    Direction:    slope = 1 for the severed pair (CLASS-γ commutative signature);
                  connected pairs: the sup is attained INSIDE the ball once
                  R > ρ* (the activation threshold) ⟹ d_R independent of R — flat.
    Conclusion:   |slope − 1| ≤ 1e-3 severed; R-dev ≤ 1e-8 connected; ρ* ≤ 10·ω_max
                  (consistency with the S100a observed flatness window). A slope ≠ 1
                  falsifies the linear-divergence form of Theorem A clause 3.
